name: What's Next
summary: The next shot of a scene: 8 cinematic continuations, Qwen Edit 2509 default; experimental Edit 2511 option.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/relight's (built by tools/build_apps.py) with next-scene_lora-v2-3000.safetensors in place of the Relight LoRA and no Relight trigger; Comfy-Org Qwen Image Edit 2509 INT8 ConvRot via native UNETLoader and per-model sub-quadratic attention; the shared Relight model chain completed one Cloud9 1024-square run on 2026-11-19, but this Next Scene variant has not been rendered separately; historical examples do not measure this INT8 profile; the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it. Experiment 2026-11-20: candidate 2511 DiT + 2511 Lightning + original Next Scene 2509 LoRA produced valid 1024px pullback in 598.16s, but extra people, changed clothing and inferred studio violated strict identity preservation. This is exposed only as an opt-in engine and original 2509 stays default. Receipt validation/qwen2511-whatsnext-nextscene2509lora-20261120.json.
